answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 13590 Country: India Title: who should go to look for marriage proposalz for the boy and girl? Question: who should go to look for marriage proposalz for the boy and girl? Answer ID: 13590 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 899/705=L/1430) The guardians of a boy or girl should look for marriage proposals, but in case of seeing a girl, responsible women of family and locality also can go. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
